_meta.emptyOnPurpose: The bank is EMPTY ON PURPOSE: there are 0 verified teachers, so Step 7 invents no questions. No question may be Published without a verified teacher writing it and a second eye (Moderator/Admin, never the author) verifying it. Bundles and keys are derived from Published questions only (buildJobBundle in src/lib/jobQuestions.ts), so they stay empty until the first question is published.

_meta.step7: Every question doc is a draft (status draft, reviewStatus Not Started) with authorId/verifiedBy/verifiedAt null — nothing is Published and nothing is verified without teacher review. Previous-year questions need examYear + sourceUrl proof. Bundles carry questions + options ONLY (no correctLetter/explanation/correctText anywhere). Keys carry the answers, one doc per bundle, receipt-gated in the rules.
